JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.stage = 'Final' AND m.match_winner = pim.team_name
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY final_wins DESC, p.player_name
LIMIT 5;

JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  AND d.innings = 1
  AND d.wides = 0
  AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id, d.over_number
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 0
   AND COUNT(*) = 6;
